channel.title: Daily Life Notes
channel.description: A daily one-page brief on home safety, everyday technology and small life fixes that actually work.

item.title: Emergency Information on Your Phone: A Fifteen-Minute Setup
item.description: A practical setup for lock-screen medical details, emergency contacts, offline maps, and a paper backup, plus the small habits that keep them current.

item.title: The 15-Minute Digital Security Tune-Up: A Practical Checklist
item.description: Four boring weaknesses cause most account break-ins. Here is the order that fixes them in one afternoon, without technical know-how.

item.title: Winter Electrical Safety: 12 Checks Before You Plug In a Space Heater
item.description: Heating appliances are the leading cause of home fires in the cold months. Twelve checks, most of them under a minute, that catch the mistakes people actually make.

item.title: Why Your Phone Battery Dies Faster in Winter (and Six Fixes That Work)
item.description: Cold weather does not damage a lithium battery permanently, but it does make it behave badly for a few hours. What is actually happening, and what genuinely helps.

item.title: Ten Smart Home Settings Worth Changing Today
item.description: Most smart-home equipment ships with the widest defaults and the thinnest privacy settings. Ten changes, ordered by how much they actually reduce risk.
